title: Run Manifest
description: Top-level manifest for a jurassic-refactor analysis or implementation run, tracking agent invocation metadata and output artifact paths.

repoUrl.description: URL of the upstream repository being analyzed.

forkUrl.description: URL of the fork where implementation changes are pushed.

profilePath.description: Relative path to the repository profile JSON file (e.g. specs/repos/odrive.profile.json).

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run started.

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the run completed.

artifactPaths.description: Relative paths to the artifacts produced by this run.
